description.value:
Cost 3 Encore

Traits Signal

You spend 3 Encore. Until the start of your next turn, every auditory and linguistic effect originating within a 120-foot emanation centered on you is suppressed, including ongoing effects already in play. You choose when you use this whether your own Broadcast and Signal effects are exempt or suppressed along with everything else. Suppressed effects resume at the end of the duration if their own duration has not expired; they are not dispelled.
